items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and create no new queue work this cycle. Compliance is a technical baseline of 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown, while operations and fleet-doctor results are unavailable. Preserve unknown revenue, ROI, causal lift, and operational outcomes. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, and failure repair-or-close work without new telemetry, requeues, spend, deployments, or monetization expansion.
